notes: Unreal Engine 1 with OldUnreal's 469f patch, on its default renderer OpenGLDrv. The ini is 469f's Default.ini with windowed 800x600, FirstRun=469 and LocalMap=UT-Logo-Map.unr, so it starts on the static title screen ('Press ESC to begin.') instead of the animated CityIntro fly-by. Checked 2026-11-14: title screen on windows-latest (Mesa llvmpipe) and on the Mac runner (Wine + Mesa llvmpipe opengl32 next to the exe; plain winemac GL has no pixel formats there). D3D11Drv works on Windows (WARP) but stays black under DXVK-macOS 1.10.3 on the runner (device FL 11_0 and swap chain created, MoltenVK floods 'VkDescriptorPool exhausted'). NEEDS two launcher features: Mesa's opengl32.dll + libgallium_wgl.dll next to the exe, and a one-time step: the disc's maps are compressed, so before the first start run System\UCC.exe decompress ..\Maps\<map>.unr.uz in System\ for CityIntro, Entry and UT-Logo-Map and move the .unr files from System\ to Maps\.
